T: Your car might be a robot. Eat anyway.
D: A teenager's first car turns out to be an alien robot, and he ends up in the middle of a war between Autobots and Decepticons.
P: Serve the snacks when the Autobots try to hide in Sam's backyard.
S: Paprika roast wedges topped with cheddar and crisp bacon
Roasted paprika potato wedges topped with melted cheddar, crisp bacon, sour cream and spring onion.
Corn chips baked with shredded chicken, black beans and cheese

Corn chips piled with shredded chicken, black beans and melted cheese, baked until bubbling and topped with tomato salsa and cool sour cream. Spread 300g corn chips on a tray. Top with 250g shredded cooked chicken, a drained tin of black beans and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Finish with salsa and sour cream.
Desert base lamb kofta with garlic yoghurt
the soldiers at the desert base in Qatar

Lamb mince with onion, cumin and parsley shaped onto skewers, grilled and served with garlic yoghurt. Mix 600g lamb mince with 1 grated onion squeezed dry, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, half a teaspoon cinnamon, chopped parsley and salt. Shape around 8 skewers into long sausages and chill 20 minutes. Grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove, lemon juice and mint. Serve with warm flatbread and sliced tomato.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, baked in foil, then charred with barbecue sauce
Pork ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, cooked at 150C for 3 hours wrapped in foil, glazed with barbecue sauce and charred, with coleslaw.
Hoover Dam beef chilli and cornbread
the secret base under the Hoover Dam

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, with sour cream and cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder. Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours. Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with sour cream.
W: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into neat cubes
Fudgy brownies baked at 170C for 25 minutes, cut into neat cubes and dusted with edible glitter.
K: Chocolate ice cream, milk and cocoa blended thick, with chocolate topping

Thick dark chocolate milkshakes, black and glossy like a fresh oil change, with chocolate topping dripping down the inside of the glass. Blend 1L chocolate ice cream, 400ml milk and 3 tbsp cocoa until thick. Pour into 4 glasses and drizzle with chocolate topping. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into wedges and toss with oil and paprika.
Roast at 220C.
Fry the bacon until crisp, grate the cheddar and slice the spring onions.
Top the wedges with cheddar and bacon and bake.
Add sour cream and spring onion.
Drain the beans and grate the cheese.
Spread the chips on a tray and top with chicken, beans and cheese.
Bake at 200C.
Finish with salsa and sour cream.
Rub the ribs with paprika, sugar and salt and wrap in foil.
Bake at 150C.
Brush with barbecue sauce and char over hot coals.
Shred the cabbage, grate the carrot and toss with mayonnaise for coleslaw.
Heat the oven to 170C and line a tin. Melt the chocolate and butter.
Whisk in the sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour.
Bake.
Cool completely.
Cut into neat cubes and dust with glitter.
Blend the ice cream, milk and cocoa until thick.
Pour into four glasses.
Drizzle with chocolate topping and serve straight away.

s.note: Paprika roast wedges topped with cheddar and crisp bacon
s.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into wedges, toss with 2 tbsp oil and 1 tsp paprika and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Top with 120g grated cheddar and 100g crisp bacon, bake 5 minutes more, then add sour cream and sliced spring onion.

s.note: Corn chips baked with shredded chicken, black beans and cheese
s.how: Spread 300g corn chips on a tray. Top with 250g shredded cooked chicken, a drained tin of black beans and 200g grated cheese and bake at 200C for 10 minutes. Finish with salsa and sour cream.

m.note: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, baked in foil, then charred with barbecue sauce
m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with smoked paprika, brown sugar and salt. Wrap in foil and bake at 150C for 3 hours. Brush with barbecue sauce and char over hot coals. Serve with a coleslaw of shredded cabbage and grated carrot in a light mayo dressing.

w.note: Fudgy dark chocolate brownies cut into neat cubes
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes and cool completely. Cut into neat cubes and dust with edible glitter so they shimmer like the cube.

d.note: Chocolate ice cream, milk and cocoa blended thick, with chocolate topping
d.how: Blend 1L chocolate ice cream, 400ml milk and 3 tbsp cocoa until thick. Pour into 4 glasses and drizzle with chocolate topping. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
